messages.subject: RE: lavaan WARNING: Could not compute standard errors z-value and p-value
parts:
Hi all,

First of all, I will like to thank Mikko for his email and suggestions
 
I ran path analysis using the Sobel Test for the year 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018.

The regression output shows that  "lavaan 0.6.17 ended normally after 1 iteration".

However, using the same approach I am concerned that except for 2018, lavaan did not generate values for  Std.Err,  z-value and P(>|z|).  Can someone explain to me why lavaan could not generate values for standard error, z-value and p-value for the year  2022, 2021, 2020, 2019. Thanks alot
